Build Per-Region Crop Area Percentage Table

Source: R/functions.R
compute_crop_percentage_table.Rd

For each region (district or catchment) in data_list, computes the percentage of total area occupied by selected_crop in every year found in the data, plus the average percentage across those years. Unlike the on-screen map (which shows either one selected year or the average), this always returns every year as its own column so an export carries the full picture regardless of which display mode was active.

compute_crop_percentage_table(data_list, selected_crop, name_col = "region")

Arguments

data_list

Named list of data frames/data.tables, one per region, each with a freq column and one or more Aggregated_YYYY/Name_YYYY crop columns

selected_crop

Character string, the crop to compute percentages for

name_col

Character string, name to use for the region-name column in the returned data frame (default "region")

Value

A data frame with one row per region: name_col, one pct_<year> column per year found across all regions, and pct_avg (the mean of that region's per-year percentages). Returns a zero-row data frame with just name_col if data_list is empty/NULL.
